title: noisemap framework config
description: Shape shared by the built-in configs and by a target repo's noisemap.config.json. Every rule is a classifier: a node kind the adapter knows how to find, plus the bucket it gets. Classification is by what a token does, never by what the framework calls the module; the same rule gives the same bucket in every config.

framework.description: Adapter id this config drives: react, spynejs, later angular/vue/svelte.

dependencies.description: package.json dependency names (a trailing slash matches a scope) that select this config.

extensions.description: Extensions always routed to this adapter.

plainExtensions.description: Extensions routed here only when the framework is detected or forced, and no earlier adapter claimed the file.

extends.description: Class names whose `extends` routes a file here (SpyneJS).

default.description: Bucket for a counted token no classifier reaches. React: L (a module that is not view, behavior, or content is computing something).

scaffolding.description: Structure that is excluded in every config (ruling 4). Only bodies count.

roles.description: Declared roles: a match rule plus an expected shape. Drift is measured against the shape.

extends.description: Regex matched against the superclass name, e.g. `ViewStream` or `DomElement|DomItem`.

methods.description: Method name → bucket for the whole method (its signature is still scaffolding), or {bucket, uniform: true} to make every counted token in the method that bucket regardless of classifiers. `constructor` names the constructor body: in SpyneJS that body is the config object.

calls.description: Callee pattern (regex) → bucket for the call, with `permitted: true` meaning it is expected and not drift.

uniform.description: Every counted token in the class body takes the role's default bucket; classifiers inside are not applied. Scaffolding and comments are still excluded. Drift is zero by definition. SpyneTrait: a trait is the logic module of the instance it is bound to.

openQuestions.description: The config's contestable calls, one line each. Copy the config, change the call, open a pull request.

rule.description: Classifier id or a short name for the rule.

id.description: Unique within the config. An override with the same id replaces the built-in classifier.

kind.description: The node kind the adapter finds. Each kind is a fixed detector in the adapter; `match` narrows it.

match.description: Regular expression tested against the kind's subject: an attribute name, a callee's source text (`new X` for constructors), an assignment's left-hand source text, a method name, a template tag.

rule.description: Rule label written into spans. Defaults to the id.

resolve.description: jsxAttribute and call only: when the value (or a call argument) is an identifier or this.member, also classify the local function it names.

minWords.description: copyString only: a string literal counts as copy at this many whitespace-separated words.

notWithin.description: copyString only: attribute names and callee names inside which a string is never copy (class lists).

allow.description: conditional only: contexts where a conditional is native to another bucket.

within.description: Method or callee name (regex) enclosing the conditional.

defaults.description: conditional only: default-value operators that are exempt from the conditional rule, e.g. `a ?? b`. Exempt unless an operand calls something that does not match `allowCalls`; with no `allowCalls`, exempt only when no operand calls anything.

allowCalls.description: Regex over callee text; calls matching it keep the exemption (SpyneJS: trait methods).

resolveBucket.description: With `resolve`: the bucket for the function the value or argument names, and for an inline function value, when it differs from `bucket`. Registration is configuration (View); the body that runs is Behavior.
